declarations.explanation: The README now provides a usable setup and preview path tied to this project, with synthetic input/output, error cases and the existing employer policy link. It distinguishes dispatch previews from carrier execution and persistence.
evidence: package.json requires Node >=24 <25 and supplies the documented npm test and preview commands; no dependencies are declared.
The actual npm test run passed both dispatch tests on this OS; npm run preview -- test/parcels.ndjson printed only {"parcelId":"demo-101","action":"dispatch"}.

src/cli.mjs reads nonblank JSON lines from the supplied file and emits records; src/dispatch.mjs selects exact ready status and requires a nonempty string id. README usage and limitations match those implementations.

declarations.explanation: The existing two-module separation is suitable. Added source notes explain the entry point, whole-file parsing, transformation boundary and tests without reorganizing code or changing behavior.
evidence: src/README.md assigns argument/file/stdout handling to cli.mjs and ready-record filtering/id validation to dispatch.mjs.
The unchanged source modules contain no network, persistence or carrier integration; source notes make those boundaries explicit and retain employer ownership.
